results.description: The clients on this page, ordered by display_name and then by client_id.

items.description: An OAuth client that an admin created for the workspace.

client_id.description: The OAuth client_id that the client sends to the authorization server. This is not the ID that usage records and usage limits use; see ai_gateway.usage_client_id.

display_name.description: The client name that admins gave the client, or client_id when it has no name.

client_type.description: Whether the client can keep a secret. Absent when it is not set.

x-enumDescriptions.CONFIDENTIAL: The client can keep a secret, for example a server-side application.
x-enumDescriptions.PUBLIC: The client cannot keep a secret, for example a desktop or command-line application.

x-speakeasy-enum-descriptions.CONFIDENTIAL: The client can keep a secret, for example a server-side application.
x-speakeasy-enum-descriptions.PUBLIC: The client cannot keep a secret, for example a desktop or command-line application.

client_type.title: PlatformOAuthClientType

grant_types.description: The OAuth grant types that the client can use.

token_endpoint_auth_method.description: How the client authenticates to the token endpoint. Absent when it is not set.

x-enumDescriptions.CLIENT_SECRET_BASIC: The client sends its secret in an HTTP Basic Authorization header.
x-enumDescriptions.CLIENT_SECRET_POST: The client sends its secret in the request body.
x-enumDescriptions.NO_AUTHENTICATION: The client does not authenticate. Public clients use this method.
x-enumDescriptions.PRIVATE_KEY_JWT: The client signs a JWT with its private key.
x-enumDescriptions.TLS_CLIENT_AUTH: The client authenticates with a mutual TLS certificate.

x-speakeasy-enum-descriptions.CLIENT_SECRET_BASIC: The client sends its secret in an HTTP Basic Authorization header.
x-speakeasy-enum-descriptions.CLIENT_SECRET_POST: The client sends its secret in the request body.
x-speakeasy-enum-descriptions.NO_AUTHENTICATION: The client does not authenticate. Public clients use this method.
x-speakeasy-enum-descriptions.PRIVATE_KEY_JWT: The client signs a JWT with its private key.
x-speakeasy-enum-descriptions.TLS_CLIENT_AUTH: The client authenticates with a mutual TLS certificate.

token_endpoint_auth_method.title: PlatformOAuthTokenEndpointAuthMethod

redirect_uris.description: The redirect URIs that the client can use.

is_active.description: Whether the client is active. A client that an admin disabled is inactive and cannot authenticate.

created_at.description: When the client was created. Absent when it is not known.

ai_gateway.description: LLM Gateway details. Present only when the client can call the Glean LLM Gateway.

usage_client_id.description: The spend-client ID that usage records and usage limits use for this client. Send it as the client_id of a usage limit. It is an opaque, case-sensitive string; do not build it from client_id.

ai_gateway.title: PlatformOAuthClientAiGateway

items.title: PlatformOAuthClient

has_more.description: Whether more clients are available after this page.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; null or absent when has_more is false.

request_id.description: Request identifier for correlating this response.

400.description: Invalid request (malformed JSON, invalid parameter values, unknown fields).

schema.description: Error response following RFC 9457, extended with `code` and `documentation_url` for machine-readable classification and self-service remediation.

title.description: Short, human-readable summary of the error.

status.description: HTTP status code mirrored from the response.

detail.description: Human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence.
detail.example: The provided cursor has expired. Start a new search to get a fresh cursor.

documentation_url.description: Direct URL to documentation for this error code.

request_id.description: Platform-generated request ID for support correlation.

errors.description: Field-level validation problems, one entry per offending field.

items.description: Field-level validation problem for a single offending field.

pointer.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer to the offending field.

detail.example: Must be one of: USER, GLEAN_AI.
